thread:
Maya Chen: Heads up — Deepwell sent back the RFI + SOW. Key asks: 6-week POC, EU-only data residency, HSM/BYOK, SOC2 evidence, and pricing tiers for Dedicated vs Hosted. Need capability matrix + written answers by EOD tomorrow. Packet: https://drive.company/Deepwell_RFI_v3.pdf
Tom Alvarez: Quick Q on the POC length — eng says 6 weeks feasible but we should propose a staged approach (3wk staging + 3wk full) to shorten ramp. @Priya any objections?
Priya Patel: Staged POC sounds reasonable. Also flag on HSM: they specifically requested FIPS 140-2 HSM + BYOK for keys at rest. We support BYOK for Dedicated/Private via customer KMS; Hosted is managed KMS only. Suggested wording below.
Priya Patel: ```
Matrix snapshot:
- Hosted: Managed KMS (no BYOK), SOC2 attestation available
- Dedicated: Customer KMS integration (BYOK supported), optional HSM peering for key material
- Private: On-prem / VPC with HSM/BYOK full support, customer-managed key lifecycle
```
Marco Rizzo: Pricing note — they want committed monthly capacity quote + overage. Sales should propose 3 tiers (Pilot, Standard POC, Committed Dedicated) with clear uplift for SLA/HSM. Draft pricing sheet uploaded: https://s3.company/pricing/deepwell_draft.xlsx
Maya Chen: Legal asked about indemnities and SLA. Deepwell wants 99.95% latency SLA for the POC. We currently offer 99.9% for Hosted and can offer 99.95% for Dedicated with a 6-month minimum and a small price uplift. @Marco can you confirm uplift % so I can draft the SLA clause?
Marco Rizzo: Confirmed — we can offer 99.95% on Dedicated with a 15% uplift and a 6-month minimum commitment or a 10% uplift with a 12-month commit. I'll put both options in the pricing sheet.
Tom Alvarez: Security question: they asked for audit/log retention of 12 months and realtime SIEM forwarding. We have 365d audit retention as part of our enterprise add-on and can stream logs to customer SIEM via Kinesis/CloudPubSub. Add to the RFI answers: yes, with configuration details.
Priya Patel: I'll compile the written RFI answers and the capability matrix into one doc. Who can do a quick tech review? Prefer someone to sanity-check HSM wording and the log forwarding specifics. @Marco please check pricing figures, @Maya legal for SLA wording.
Maya Chen: I'll handle the legal review + compliance checks. Also please confirm whether Deepwell can accept staged POC — I'm going to reach out to their contact (Alex) after we have the first draft.
sales-bot: Attachment uploaded: deepwell_rfi_answers_v1.docx (uploaded by Priya Patel)
Maya Chen: Action items: Priya produce v1 by 12:00pm PT tomorrow, Marco update pricing with uplift and both commit options, Tom confirm SIEM forwarding config snippet, Maya to draft SLA clause and send to Alex for acceptance. :thumbsup: :eyes:
Tom Alvarez: I'll paste the SIEM snippet inline in the doc before 11am.
Priya Patel: Thanks — I'll mark the doc as "internal review" then share to the sales thread for final sign-off.
